name: VirExit Technologies, Inc.
summary: VirExit Technologies, Inc. develops and provides antiviral technologies, personal protective equipment, and health and wellness products. It offers seated treadmills, nutraceuticals, and boutique style custom candles through its safer place market. The company was formerly known as Poverty Dignified, Inc. VirExit Technologies, Inc. was founded in 2013 and is headquartered in Richland, Washington.
